units.title: Foundations of Artificial Intelligence for Robotics
units.topics: Introduction to Artificial Intelligence: AI vs Automation vs Robotics, intelligent agents, problem formulation, state space representation, AI techniques (search, optimization, learning, rule-based systems) and role of AI in manufacturing and robotics. Applications of AI in robotics and automation: industrial robots, mobile robots, flexible manufacturing systems and real-world intelligent system examples.

units.title: Search and Metaheuristic Optimization Techniques
units.topics: State space search methods: uninformed search (BFS, DFS), informed search (Best First Search, A*), heuristic functions and problem solving in robotics. Metaheuristic optimization techniques: Genetic Algorithm, Simulated Annealing, Tabu Search and Ant Colony Optimization (with numerical) and applications in path planning, routing and scheduling.

units.title: Handling Uncertainty in Robotics
units.topics: Probability concepts for robotics, Bayesian reasoning, sensor uncertainty and decision making under uncertainty. Kalman Filter (concept and application), Fuzzy Logic (fuzzy sets, membership functions, rule -based control) and applications in localization, sensor fusion and robot control.

units.title: Machine Learning for Robotics
units.topics: Introduction to Machine Learning, supervised and unsupervised learning, classification and regression concepts, K-Means clustering (concept), Support Vector Machine and Neural Networks (introductory). Model evaluation, overfitting and applications of machine learning in robotics including object classification, fault detection and predictive maintenance.

units.title: Machine Vision in Robotics and Intelligent Systems
units.topics: Fundamentals of Digital Images and Processing: binary, grayscale and RGB images, centroid calculation (binary, grayscale, RGB), image resolution, digital image processing steps, smoothing, sharpening, thresholding, gradient and edge detection (Sobel, Prewitt, Roberts, LoG, Canny). Segmentation, Matching, Compression and Vision Systems: threshold, region, edge and K -Means segmentation; SSD and NCC; lossless (RLE, Huffman, LZW) and lossy (JPEG, DCT, Wavelet) compression; machine vision system, imaging-based sorting, inspection and robot guidance applications. Learning Resources

units.title: Fundamentals of Microprocessor 8085
units.topics: Basic Architecture of 8085, Buses: Data, Address, Control, Memory & I/O Interfacing Basics Instruction Set Overview, Programming example of 8085

units.title: 8086 Microprocessor
units.topics: 8086 Architecture, Addressing Modes of 8086, Instruction Set of 8086, Interrupts in 8086 Programming example 8086.

units.title: Introduction to Microcontroller 8051
units.topics: Microprocessor vs Microcontroller, CISC vs RISC,8051 Architecture, Memory Organization of 8051,8051 Instruction Set & Addressing, Timers & Counters, Interrupts & Serial Communication

units.title: PIC18F458 Microcontroller
units.topics: Introduction to PIC18F458, PIC18 Architecture, PIC18 I/O Ports & Configuration, PIC18 Timers & PWM, ADC in PIC18F458, PIC18 Interrupts & UART.

units.title: Application of Microcontrollers
units.topics: Microcontrollers in Robotics, Microcontroller-Based Robot Control, Sensor Interfacing for Robots, Microcontroller-Based Automation. Learning Resources

units.title: Introduction to Robotics and Kinematics
units.topics: History & Applications of Robotics, Robot Components & Classifications, Degrees of Freedom (DoF), Frames and Coordinate Systems, Rotation Matrices & Homogeneous Transformation, Euler Angles, Roll–Pitch–Yaw Representations

units.title: Forward & Inverse Kinematics of Manipulators
units.topics: Forward Kinematics, Denavit–Hartenberg (D–H) Convention, Inverse Kinematics, Solution Strategies, Redundancy & Multiple Solutions, Examples: 2-link Planar, 6-DOF Industrial Manipulator

units.title: Differential Motion & Velocity Kinematics
units.topics: Linear & Angular Velocity, Jacobian Matrix Formulation, Relation between joint and end–effector velocities, Singularity Analysis, Manipulability and Condition Number, Velocity Mapping, Static Force Relationships

units.title: Dynamics of Manipulators
units.topics: Kinetic & Potential Energy, Lagrange–Euler Formulation, Newton–Euler Formulation, Dynamic Equation of Motion, Mass Matrix, Coriolis & Centrifugal Terms, Dynamic Effects in Motion Planning, Simulation Examples

units.title: Trajectory Planning and Control
units.topics: Trajectory Generation, Polynomial & Spline Trajectories, Trajectory Constraints, Control Architecture, Feedback Linearization, Simulation & Practical Implementation Learning Resources

units.title: Introduction to Computer Integrated Manufacturing
units.topics: Introduction to manufacturing systems, evolution of manufacturing, conventional manufacturing versus automated manufacturing, concept and definition of CIM, need and scope of CIM, CIM wheel and CIM architecture. Elements of CIM system: CAD, CAM, CNC, robotics, automated material handling systems, manufacturing planning and control, databases and communication systems. Benefits, limitations, and applications of CIM in modern industries. Introduction to Industry 4.0 and smart manufacturing.

units.title: Computer-Aided Manufacturing
units.topics: Fundamentals of CAD: geometric modeling, wireframe, surface and solid modeling, product data representation, computer graphics concepts. Computer-Aided Manufacturing: NC, CNC and DNC systems, CNC machine components, part programming concepts, adaptive control in manufacturing. Integration of CAD and CAM, computer-aided process planning (CAPP), applications of CAD/CAM in product development and manufacturing industries.

units.title: Group Technology and Flexible Manufacturing Systems
units.topics: Group Technology (GT): concept, advantages, part families, classification and coding systems, production flow analysis. Flexible Manufacturing Systems (FMS): concept, objectives, components and configurations of FMS. FMS elements: machine tools, material handling systems, storage systems, automated guided vehicles (AGVs), industrial robots and computer control systems. Applications, advantages and limitations of FMS in automated production environments.

units.title: Manufacturing Planning and Control Systems
units.topics: Manufacturing planning and control functions, production planning and scheduling, inventory control systems, bill of materials and routing. Material Requirement Planning (MRP), Manufacturing Resource Planning (MRP -II), Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) concepts. Shop floor control, production monitoring, quality control systems and database management in CIM. Computer communication and networking in manufacturing systems.

units.title: Automation, Robotics and Modern Trends in CIM
units.topics: Industrial automation concepts, types of automation, sensors and actuators used in automated manufacturing. Role of industrial robots in CIM, robot applications in material handling, welding, assembly, inspection and packaging. Introduction to automated inspection systems, machine vision systems and automated storage and retrieval systems (ASRS). Modern trends in CIM: IoT in manufacturing, digital twin, cloud manufacturing, cyber physical systems, smart factories and AI applications in manufacturing. Learning Resources

units.title: Principles of Simulation and Modeling
units.topics: Review of probability and statistics for simulation, definition and concepts of modeling and simulation, role of simulation in engineering systems, steps in a simulation study, system definition and problem formulation, modeling concepts and abstraction levels, system boundaries and assumptions, model-based problem solving, advantages, disadvantages and limitations of simulation, application areas in robotics, automation and manufacturing systems.

units.title: Simulation System Types and Methodologies
units.topics: Types of simulation: physical vs mathematical models, static vs dynamic systems, deterministic vs stochastic systems, continuous vs discrete systems, discrete -event simulation, continuous simulation, Monte Carlo simulation, hybrid simulation models, applications in inventory systems, queuing systems, system logic development, event scheduling and system state variables.

units.title: Input Modeling and Random Number Generation
units.topics: Nature of simulation input data, data collection methods, sources of data, data preprocessing, identifying probability distributions, histogram analysis, goodness -of-fit tests, practical methods for testing assumptions, introduction to random number genera tion, properties of random numbers, pseudo-random number generators, congruential generators, testing randomness, applications in simulation modeling.

units.title: Random Variate Generation and Output Analysis
units.topics: Introduction to random variate generation, selection of random variate generators, generating continuous random variables: uniform, exponential, normal, Weibull, Poisson distributions, inverse transform method, acceptance–rejection method, output data analysis, terminating and non-terminating simulations, steady-state analysis, confidence interval estimation, model verification and validation, sensitivity analysis.

units.title: Simulation of Robotics, Manufacturing and Automation Systems
units.topics: Need of simulation in robotics and automation systems, components of robotic and manufacturing systems – product, resources, demand, control, downtime, failures, rework, reentrancy, random events, performance measures in robotic and manufacturing systems, simulation of material handling systems, automated conveyor systems, AGVs and mobile robots, job shop simulation, flexible manufacturing systems (FMS), digital factory concepts, in troduction to simulation software tools, case study on a robotic manufacturing system. Learning Resources

units.title: Introduction to artificial intelligent techniques
units.topics: Goals of AI in manufacturing, tools for AI such as Search algorithm, Mathematical optimization, Evolutionary computation, fuzzy logic, Probabilistic methods for uncertain reasoning such as Bayesian network, Hidden Markov model, Kalman filter, Decision theo ry and Utility theory, statistical learning methods, support vector machines, neural networks, expert systems.

units.title: Industrial planning and decision making using intelligent systems
units.topics: Production planning using fuzzy cognitive maps, computer aided process planning, Methods for inventory space allocation and storage processes analysis, Optimization of production costs and methods finding of the best process plan, Methods for production eq uipment selection and layout, Heuristic scheduling of multiple resources, Fuzzy multiple attribute decision making methods.

units.title: Intelligent techniques for manufacturing process optimization
units.topics: Application of neural networks and fuzzy sets to machining and metal forming, Artificial neural network modeling of surface quality characteristics in machining processes, parametric optimization of machining processes using evolutionary optimization methods.

units.title: Knowledge Based Group Technology
units.topics: Group Technology: Models and Algorithms – Visual method, Coding method, Cluster analysis method Knowledge based group technology – Group technology in automated manufacturing system, Structure of knowledge based system for group technology (KBSGT) –database, knowledge base, Clustering algorithms.

units.title: Intelligent robotic systems
units.topics: Applications of intelligent systems for mobile Robot Motion Planning, Path Planning Robot Control in Dynamic Environments, Task Based Hybrid Closure Grasping Optimization for Autonomous Robot Hand. Accurate Motion Control of Fast Mobile Robots, obstacle avoidance. Applications of Intelligent techniques in flexible manufacturing systems (FMS). Learning Resources

units.title: Introduction Industrial Robots
units.topics: Types of industrial robots, Load handling capacity, general considerations in Robotic material handling, material transfer, machine loading and unloading, CNC machine tool loading, Robot centered cell.

units.title: Storage and Data capturing systems
units.topics: Conventional storage methods and equipment’s, Storage system performance, Analysis of Automated storage/retrieval systems (ASRS) and Carousel Storage system. Automatic data capturing system (ADC), Bar coding, Radio frequency identification (RFID), Optical character recognition, Magnetic stripes

units.title: Introduction to Industrial Robots
units.topics: Types of industrial robots, Load handling capacity, general considerations in Robotic material handling, material transfer, machine loading and unloading, CNC machine tool loading, Robot centered cell.

units.title: End Effectors
units.topics: Classification, Design consideration, Materials for hostile operation. Cylindrical Cam type; Grippers using pneumatic, hydraulic and electrical motor for transmission; Vacuum Grippers, Ultrasonic grippers. Gripper force analysis and gripper design, design of multiple degrees of freedom, active and passive grippers. Selection of Robot: Factors influencing the choice of a robot, robot performance testing, economics of robotization, Impact of robot on industry and society.

units.title: Applications of Robots
units.topics: Pick and place Robot, Application of Robots in Arc Welding Robots, Assembly and mega -assembly Robots continuous arc welding, Spot welding, Spray painting, assembly operation Other industrial applications: Coating, Deburring, cleaning, Die Casting, Moulding, Material handling, Picking, Palletizing, Packaging, Military and medical applications, robot for underwater applications Robots, Climbing Robots, Machine mounted Robots. Robots For Inspection: Robotic vision systems, image representation, object recognition and categorization, Depth measurement Learning Resources

units.title: Introduction to Data Science and Data Handling
units.topics: Introduction to Data Science, data-driven decision making, applications in robotics and automation, data science life cycle, types of data (structured, unstructured), data collection methods (sensors, logs, IoT devices), basics of Excel for data handling, data cleaning (duplicates, missing values, formatting).

units.title: Data Preprocessing and Exploratory Data Analysis
units.topics: Data preprocessing techniques: filtering, sorting, normalization (concept), encoding categorical data (concept), descriptive statistics (mean, median, variance, standard deviation), correlation analysis, univariate and bivariate analysis, visualization using Excel (bar chart, pie chart, histogram, scatter plot, line chart), introduction to inferential statistics, introduction to dashboards.

units.title: Basic Predictive Analytic
units.topics: Introduction to predictive analytics, regression concept (linear regression using Excel trendline), classification concept (rule-based logic), evaluation metrics (MAE, RMSE, accuracy concept), bias and variance (conceptual), real -world robotics examples (f ault prediction, energy forecasting, production data).

units.title: Clustering and Applications in Robotics
units.topics: Introduction to clustering, K-Means concept (visual explanation), grouping and segmentation using Excel, introduction to free visualization tools (Google Data Studio / Power BI free / Tableau Public), mini case studies: sensor data analysis, production quality monitoring, student performance analytics. Learning Resources

units.title: Fundamentals of Sensors and Characteristics
units.topics: Physical Principles of Sensing Electric Charges, Fields, and Potentials; Capacitance; Magnetism; Induction; Resistance; Piezoelectric Effect; Hall Effect Sensor Performance Characteristics, Types of Sensors Sensor Signal Conditioning, Conditioning Bridge Circuits, Amplifying and Linearizing Bridge Outputs, Amplifiers for Signal Conditioning, Precision Op Amp Characteristics, Instrumentation Amplifiers. Data-Acquisition Systems: Hardware and Software of Data Acquisitions System (DAS).

units.title: Mechanical Transducers
units.topics: Transduction methods, accelerometers, gyroscopes, pressure sensors, MEMS microphones, mechanical structures, actuators. Chemical and Biological Transducers: basic concepts of cellular biology, chemical sensors, molecule -based biosensors, cell -based biosens ors, chemical actuators, biological transducers, Recent Trends – Smart Pressure Transmitters, Selection of Sensors, Rotary Variable Differential Transformer (RVDT), Synchros and Resolvers, Induction Potentiometers.

units.title: Thermal Sensors
units.topics: Definition of Temperature: Thermal Energy, absolute and relative Temperature, Metal resistance versus temperature devices: Resistance versus Temperature Approximations, Resistance-Temperature Detectors (RTD), Thermistors, Semiconductor Resistance versus Te mperature, Thermistor Characteristics, thermocouples, Thermoelectric Effects, Thermocouple, Characteristics, Thermocouple Sensors, Other thermal sensor: Bimetal Strips, Gas Thermometers, Radiation pyrometers, Optical pyrometers. Wire Anemometers. liquid flow meters.

units.title: Important Sensors and Applications
units.topics: Resistive, Capacitive, and Inductive Sensors, Variable -Reluctance Sensors, LVDT, Level Sensors, Acceleration, Shock and Vibration Sensors: Piezoelectric Accelerometer, Piezo resistive Accelerometers, Applicable Standards, Interfacing and Designs, Latest Developments, Quartz Sensors, sensor types, Applicable Standards Strain Gage Sensors, types, Applicable Standards, Metal Strain Gauges and Semiconductor Strain Gauges (SGs), Load Cells

units.title: Recent Technologies
units.topics: (08 Hours) Film sensors, Micro -electromechanical sensors, Nano -sensors. Applications of Sensors –On-board Automobile sensors, home appliance sensors, Aerospace sensors, Sensors for manufacturing, medical diagnostic sensors, Sensors for Environmental Monitoring, Photo sensors, Thermal Detectors, Phototransistor, Position and Motion Sensors. Introduction to Nanotechnology -Enabled, Sensors, Bio Sensors. Learning Resources

units.title: Introduction of Embedded System
units.topics: Introduction to embedded systems, classification, characteristics and comparison with general-purpose computing systems. Basic structure of embedded systems including power supply, sensors, A/D and D/A converters, processor, memory, and actuators. Embedded system design flow, Applications in robotics and automation, and considerations of safety, reliability, environmental issues, and ethical practices.

units.title: Embedded Hardware and Communication
units.topics: Overview of ARM architecture with focus on LPC2148 microcontroller. Study of LPC2148 block diagram, pin configuration, memory organization, GPIO, timers, watchdog timer, RTC, ADC, and DAC. Introduction to serial communication concepts and protocols such as UART, SPI, and I²C for embedded and robotic applications.

units.title: Embedded system programming
units.topics: Embedded C programming concepts including data types, variables, operators, functions. GPIO programming using LPC2148, interfacing of LEDs, switches, LCDs and sensors using ADC. Basics of motor control and UART-based serial communication for real-time embedded applications.

units.title: Real-Time Operating Systems
units.topics: Introduction to real-time embedded systems, Need in robotics and automation, Hard and soft real -time systems, Task scheduling, Context switching, IPC and synchronization mechanisms. Overview of Free RTOS, Applications of RTOS-based robotic and automation systems.

units.title: Linux Fundamentals and Case Studies
units.topics: Introduction to Embedded Linux, Linux architecture, basic commands, VI editor and fundamentals of device drivers including kernel modules, applications and types of drivers. Case Studies: Communication Between Orchestra Robots, Embedded System for an Adaptive Cruise Control (ACC) System in a Car, Embedded System for a Smart Card, Embedded System for a Mobile Phone Learning Resources

units.title: Introduction to Flexible Manufacturing Systems (FMS) and Cellular
units.topics: Manufacturing (08 Hours) Introduction and definition of FMS, Basic components of FMS, Significance, objectives, benefits and limitations of FMS, General layout and configuration of FMS, Areas of industrial applications, CIM technology, Hierarchy of CIM, FMS justification. Cellular Manufacturing: Introduction, description and classifications of cells, unattended machining, Cellular manufacturing versus Flexible manufacturing. Group Technology: Introduction, definition, reasons for adopting GT, benefits of GT, obstacles to application of GT.

units.title: Computer Aided Manufacturing (CAM) and CNC Programming
units.topics: Concepts and features of NC, CNC and DNC, feedback devices, interpolators, point -to-point and contouring systems, interchangeable tooling system, preset and qualified tools, ISO specification. Machining center and turning center. CNC Programming: Machine tool coordinate system, machine zero and job zero, cutter programming, tool offsets, manual part programming, G -codes and M -codes, canned cycles, sample part programs for turning and milling operations. CAM packages and applications.

units.title: Computer Integrated Manufacturing (CIM) and Production
units.topics: Management (08 Hours) Computer applications in manufacturing automation, computer aided inspection and quality control. Computer integrated production management systems, inventory management, Material Requirement Planning (MRP), Manufacturing Resource Planning (MRP-II), Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP). Rapid product development and manufacture, extended enterprises and integrated manufacturing systems.

units.title: Automated Material Handling and Storage Systems
units.topics: Introduction to Automated Material Handling Systems, Types of AGVs and working principles, AGV guide paths, advantages and limitations of AGVs. Industrial robots in material handling applications. Automated Storage and Retrieval Systems (ASRS): basic components, benefits and applications. Conveyors and pallet flotation systems, queuing carousels, automatic work changers, coolant and chip disposal and recovery systems.

units.title: Cutting Tools and Tool Management
units.topics: Introduction to cutting tools and tool management systems. Control of cutting tools, tool strategies, tool presetting, tool identification and data transfer systems. Tool monitoring systems, fault detection methods and modern trends in tool management for automated manufacturing systems.

units.title: Reliability Engineering for Robotics
units.topics: Introduction to reliability engineering, Reliability terminology: MTBF, MTTF, failure rate, availability, Bathtub curve and failure patterns, Probability distributions: Exponential and Weibull (basic concepts), Reliability Block Diagrams (RBD), Series and parallel system reliability, Maintainability and availability analysis.

units.title: Failure Analysis and Diagnostics
units.topics: Types of failures: Mechanical, Electrical, Control & Software, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA), Fault Tree Analysis (FTA), Predictive and preventive maintenance strategies, Condition monitoring and health diagnostics, Introduction to AI-based fault detection.

units.title: Robot Safety Standards and Compliance
units.topics: Hazard identification and risk assessment, international safety standards overview: International Organization for Standardization – ISO 10218, Occupational Safety and Health Administration – OSHA guidelines, Safety Integrity Levels (SIL – introductory), M achine guarding and safety devices (light curtains, interlocks, E-stops), Safety validation and documentation.

units.title: Functional Safety and Human –Robot Collaboration
units.topics: Functional safety principles, Overview of ISO 13849, Safety-rated monitored stop, Speed and separation monitoring, Power and force limiting, Ergonomics and human factors in robotics

units.title: Risk Assessment and Safe Robotic System Design
units.topics: Risk assessment methodologies, Hazard analysis and risk reduction techniques, Safety PLC – basic concept and redundancy, Safe robotic cell layout design, Safety lifecycle management, Case studies: Automotive and Smart Manufacturing, Cybersecurity considerations in robotic safety. Learning Resources

subjects.title: Robot System Reliability and Safety Lab

units.title: Introduction to Hybrid Vehicles
units.topics: Need for hybridization of automobiles, Environmental impact and emission norms (BS-VI, global standards), Classification of Hybrid Vehicles, Micro, Mild, Full, Plug-in Hybrid, Comparison: Conventional IC Engine, Electric Vehicle, Hybrid Vehicle. Overview of major hybrid vehicle manufacturers and models.

units.title: Hybrid Powertrain Architectures
units.topics: Components of Hybrid Electric Vehicle (HEV), Series Hybrid Configuration, Parallel Hybrid Configuration, Series-Parallel (Power Split) Hybrid Configuration, Mechanical Coupling Devices, Case studies of hybrid vehicle architecture.

units.title: Energy Storage Systems & Power Electronics
units.topics: Battery technologies: Lead Acid, Nickel Metal Hydride (NiMH), Lithium-ion. Ultracapacitors and Fuel Cells (Introduction), Battery Management System (BMS), DC -DC Converters, Inverters and Motor Drives, Regenerative Braking System.

units.title: Control Strategies & Energy Management
units.topics: Energy Management Strategies, Rule-Based Control, Fuzzy Logic Control, Model Predictive Control, Supervisory Control Systems, Hybrid Vehicle Drive Cycles, State of Charge (SOC) Estimation. Integration with Embedded Systems. Introduction to AI-based energy optimization

units.title: Intelligent Hybrid Systems & Future Trends
units.topics: Hybrid Vehicles in Smart Transportation Systems, Integration with Industrial IoT and Smart Grids. Autonomous and Connected Hybrid Vehicles, Vehicle -to-Grid (V2G) Technology, Hydrogen Hybrid Systems. Future trends in Sustainable Mobility Learning Resources

units.topics: Definition and characteristics of humanoid robots, History and evolution, Comparison with industrial robots Applications and challenges, Degrees of freedom (conceptual understanding)

units.title: Mechanical Structure of Humanoid Robots
units.topics: Basic body structure (head, torso, limbs), Joints and links, Actuators (motors, servos – overview), Power sources, Examples of popular humanoid robots

units.title: Motion and Balance Basics
units.topics: Concept of bipedal locomotion, Stability and balance (intuitive concepts), Walking and simple movements, Center of gravity (basic idea), Common movement challenges

units.title: Sensors and Perception
units.topics: Need for sensors in humanoid robots, Vision sensors (cameras), Distance and touch sensors, Inertial sensors (basic idea), Role of sensor feedback.

units.title: Applications and Simulation Overview
units.topics: Service and assistive robots, Humanoid robots in research and industry, Introduction to Application in Industry, Ethical and societal aspects, Future trends. Learning Resources

units.title: Introduction To Mechatronic Systems
units.topics: Basics of Mechatronics Systems: Definition of Mechatronics, Key elements of Mechatronics Systems, Levels of mechatronics systems. Integrated product design concepts, basics of system modeling, analysis, simulation tools, and introduction to human–machine interface used in automation and robotic systems.

units.title: Sensors and Sensing Technologies
units.topics: Classification and characteristics of sensors and transducers with recent developments. Opto -electronic sensors, shaft encoders, proximity and optical sensors, introduction to machine vision systems, and basic signal conditioning concepts relevant to industrial automation.

units.title: Drives, Actuators and Embedded Control Systems
units.topics: Hydraulic, pneumatic, and electrical actuators including stepper and servo motors with drive circuits. Open- loop and closed-loop control concepts, fundamentals of embedded systems hardware and software, basic industrial communication, programmable logic devices, and real-time control systems.

units.title: Smart Materials And Intelligent Actuators
units.topics: Introduction to smart materials such as shape memory alloys, piezoelectric, and magnetostrictive actuators. Material properties, static and dynamic characteristics, and applications in precision positioning, vibration control, and adaptive mechatronic systems.

units.title: Micro-Mechatronic Systems and Modern Applications
units.topics: Micro sensors and micro actuators with an overview of microfabrication techniques including the LIGA process. Application examples and case studies from robotics, manufacturing automation, machine diagnostics, automotive systems and medical technology . Learning Resources

units.title: Introduction to Wireless Sensor Networks
units.topics: Concept, evolution of Wireless Sensor Networks. Sensor node architecture and components. WSN architecture, Types of WSNs, and design challenges. Performance metrics such as energy efficiency, latency, reliability, and network lifetime. Applications of WSNs in robotics and industrial automation.

units.title: Wireless Communication and Link Management
units.topics: Basics of radio communication, wireless channel characteristics and modulation concepts. Medium Access Control (MAC) protocols. Wireless link properties, error control techniques, naming and addressing and topology control in sensor networks.

units.title: WSN Standards and Protocol Stack
units.topics: WSN protocol stack and cross -layer design. Overview of low -power wireless standards including IEEE 802.15.4, ZigBee, Bluetooth Low Energy , Wireless HART, ISA 100.11a, 6LoWPAN, and Z -Wave. Comparison of standards for robotics and automation applications..

units.topics: Clustering and data aggregation techniques. In -network processing and data fusion. Security requirements, attacks, and basic defense mechanisms in WSNs. Design, deployment, testing, and validation of WSN applications for robotics and automation. Learning Resources

units.topics: Introduction to AWS cloud platform, EC2 (virtual machines), S3 (cloud storage), IAM (identity and access management), AWS IoT Core (overview), data ingestion and storage workflow, hosting basic applications and dashboards on cloud.
